name: Amla
description: Sour green gooseberry — the one sour fruit the traditions call cooling.

tcm.note: Outside the Chinese record; placed from its sour-astringent character.

ayurveda.note: The textbook exception: amla is amla-rasa (sour) yet shita virya, and the only rasayana that pacifies all three doshas.

unani.note: Aamla is barid-yabis in Unani, a standard ingredient of cooling and blood-purifying formulas.

histamine.note: Not itself on the SIGHI list; sour fruits generally sit low-to-middling.

nutrition.highlight: one of the densest vitamin C sources

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
